name: Backwindow Webapp
description: A Salesforce login service that allows multiple users to sign in to multiple orgs without sharing any credentials or passwords

SESSION_SECRET.description: A secret key for verifying the integrity of signed cookies.

SF_JWT_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID (consumer key) of the Connected App used for JWT bearer login into the target org(s)

SF_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64.description: Private key of the cert in the JWT Connected App, encoded in base64. To encode a key file to base64, execute `openssl base64 -A ./path/to/server.key`

ALLOWED_USER_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated list of Google accounts (email addresses) that are allowed to use the backwindow app to login to the target orgs

AGENT_API_KEY.description: Static API key for agent/programmatic access via POST /api/backwindow

GH_OIDC_AUDIENCE.description: Expected aud claim for GitHub Actions OIDC token verification

GH_OIDC_ALLOWED_REPOS.description: Comma-separated list of GitHub repositories (e.g. owner/repo) allowed to authenticate via OIDC

SF_LOGIN_URL.description: Salesforce login URL used for production orgs
